tools.why: Turns an office document (doc/docx/odt and friends) under the cursor into a picture in the hover window instead of a plain format badge — the conversion runs through pdfport.nvim's soffice producer. On Windows the LibreOffice installer does not extend PATH, so this can report missing on a machine where LibreOffice is plainly installed: add the LibreOffice `program` directory to PATH, or `:Hover office off` to stop asking.

Renders the first page of a PDF under the cursor as the hover preview, rather than reporting it as bytes. Ships with poppler and is reached through pdfport.nvim — both have to be present, `:checkhealth hover` says which is missing.
